map.血钙要校正吗？: Does the blood calcium need correction?
map.要。低白蛋白会假性降低总钙，常用校正钙=总钙+0.02×(40−白蛋白 g/L): Yes. A low albumin falsely lowers total calcium; the common corrected calcium = total calcium + 0.02*(40 - albumin g/L); ionised calcium is more direct.
map.输入血钙和PTH水平，结合血磷和维生素D，判读甲状旁腺反馈轴状态与病因: Enter the blood calcium and PTH levels and, together with phosphorus and vitamin D, interpret the state of the parathyroid feedback axis and the cause
map.骨质疏松伴 PTH 升高时的判读。: Interpretation when osteoporosis accompanies elevated PTH.
map.高钙伴 PTH 不抑制（仍高）指向原发性甲旁亢；高钙伴 PTH 受抑多为非甲旁亢: High calcium with non-suppressed (still high) PTH points to primary hyperparathyroidism; high calcium with suppressed PTH is more often non-parathyroid hypercalcaemia (such as malignancy or granulomatous disease).
map.高钙血症的病因鉴别（甲旁亢 vs 恶性/肉芽肿病）。: Differential diagnosis of hypercalcaemia (hyperparathyroidism versus malignancy/granulomatous disease).
map.：血钙 2.9 mmol/L（校正后高）+ PTH 120 pg/mL（高）→原: : calcium 2.9 mmol/L (high after correction) plus PTH 120 pg/mL (high) -> primary hyperparathyroidism; another case with calcium 2.0 and PTH 220 (high) -> secondary hyperparathyroidism (vitamin D deficiency / CKD). Low calcium plus low PTH suggests hypoparathyroidism.
